g.text: Distributions show 500 descriptive site-balanced bootstrap resamples.
P values use 999 within-location label permutations and BH correction across eight metrics.
Topology of the full 18-family candidate set
Project-matched DNA viromes from Orbicella faveolata coral tissue at five Florida locations.
Panels a,b show the 11-family stable-edge union; topology tests retain all 18 families.
Viral family association networks across coral health states
